newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending Thursday's dip.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending Thursday's dip.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall for the second consecutive day, after the market rose 4.5 percent in the previous four sessions.

Some analysts said most stocks looked fairly valued or slightly expensive but they said any falls shouldn't be deep and expected 16,000 to provide a strong support for the market, currently at 16,968.8.
Poland's biggest paper firm Celuloza SA starts trade on the main market on Friday and analysts expected the price to be slightly above Tuesday's allotment price of 20.5 zlotys.
